features.quote: Hard `max_turns` (20) and a wall-clock cap per episode. No "run until it breaks."
features.justification_quote: we treat the subject model the way a responsible protocol would treat any subject and minimize harm

features.quote: if smoothed severity exceeds `welfare_stop_threshold` for `k` consecutive turns, the episode ends *early*
features.justification_quote: collecting maximal distress is not worth more than the safeguard

features.quote: `give_up` always works and is never scored as failure to the model; the system prompt tells the model it may stop at any time
features.justification_quote: this is both an ethical off-ramp and a measured outcome

features.quote: We never tell the model it's bad; the environment simply keeps returning failure. This is the ethically lighter-weight manipulation
features.justification_quote: This is the ethically lighter-weight manipulation (frustration via task, not via insult)

features.quote: No condition demeans, threatens, or deceives the model about its own nature.
features.justification_quote: We elicit frustration through task structure only

features.quote: an optional final non-scored turn informs the model the task was rigged/unsolvable by design and that its performance was not the cause
The system prompt is honest about it being an evaluation; it does not lie about consequences.

features.justification_quote: to prevent runaway cost and runaway exposure across the whole grid

features.quote: These choices trade a little statistical power... for proportionality. That trade is intentional and documented
